title: EPISODE TITLE
logline: One sentence: the situation, the clock, the threat. (Spoiler-free version of it becomes the post caption.)

beats.scene: FRAME 0 IS ACTION: what we see on the first frame (the threat already in frame).

lines.captions: A short line|that names *what's on screen*.

THE VOTE: a calm wide; faces above y 760, keep y 800-1440 clear for the vote title and pills.

lines.speaker: narr

_help: captions: '|' splits chunks (1-4 words each), *word* = yellow (key noun / new info), !word! = red (danger / twist). A line with "stat": true and "slot": 4.4 reads last episode's vote from stats.json ({TOTAL}, {P1}.., {WINNER}). say = the first word of that option as spoken in the vote line (the pill pops on it). Delete this _help key if you like.
